`final class VertexFill`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.vertex` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [VertexFill.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/vertex/VertexFill.java)

Copies a vertex buffer into memory of the backend and writes neutral values where the draw left optional attributes out.

## Description

An API with a fixed vertex input, such as Vulkan, reads every attribute of every vertex.
`VertexFill` makes the bytes that a draw did not write safe to read: the texture coordinate `(0, 0)` and the normal `(0, 0, 1)`.
It leaves the color as it is: the translated shader takes the current color of the render state when the buffer has no colors.

### complete

`ByteBuffer complete(VertexBuffer buffer, ByteBuffer target)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>
